_meta.task: #7 settings-re — panel-ready knob catalog for the V2 Tuning-Knobs panel
_meta.source: SETTINGSUPDATE-MESSAGE-SHAPE-2026-06-13.md (live ground-truth) + blessed binary RE (SETTINGSUPDATE-SERVERGAMEPLAYSETTINGS-RE-2026-06-13.md) + cross-ref v3-admin-knobs.json + RATE-MULTIPLIER-SYSTEMS-RE-2026-06-13.md
_meta.scope: The 24 EServerGameplaySettingType settings carried in the serverGameplaySettings body. These are the ONLY knobs applied via the settingsUpdate/server_state message path. Other v3-admin-knobs.json entries (landclaim segments, PvpEnabledPartitions, CAT B thresholds, spice density, SandStormConfig, Coriolis cycle, exchange fees) are a SEPARATE config surface NOT carried in this body — out of scope for this apply recipe.

transport.body_wrapper: full server_state frame with serverGameplaySettings{ Difficulty:"Custom", <5 categories> }
transport.encoding: every value is a JSON STRING; bools "True"/"False" (Core/Combat/Persistence) or "1"/"0" (Survival sandstorm/sandworm); send FULL snapshot (changed + last-known)
transport.verify: read next server_state echo on completions/server_state.<Map>_<partition> and diff changed keys

persistence_model.runtime: publish applies via BindServerGameplaySetting CVar callback; holds until next server RESTART
persistence_model.no_director_reassert: live director does NOT re-push serverGameplaySettings on cadence (only PerMapConfig BuildOverrides), so a publish is NOT clobbered on the ~30s cycle — corrects the RATE-MULTIPLIER 'INI clobbered' theory
persistence_model.cross_restart: to survive restart, the upstream Funcom orchestration / battlegroupoperator gameplay-settings template must be updated (delivered at the BGD InitializeDirector handshake at boot) — separate windowed task, DR-critical image
persistence_model.why_ini_inert: these CVars are (re)seeded from the director handshake at boot; INI edits in non-authoritative layers never reach the bound value

field_legend.applyConfidence: HIGH = [bin] exact CVar literal in binary; MED = [prop] binds to UPROPERTY/subsystem field (value confirmed, literal not isolated)
field_legend.exposeStatus: exposed = surfaced in current v3-admin-knobs catalog; unexposed = present on the wire but not yet in the panel catalog (the '5 unexposed')
field_legend.onlineSafety: online-safe = apply on a populated server with no disruption; online-caution-announce = technically online but high player-facing impact, announce first; window-recommended = apply on empty server / maintenance window
field_legend.applyStatus: PROVEN = effect confirmed live; UNPROVEN = mechanism RE'd but runtime apply via settingsUpdate not yet live-confirmed on build 1988751
field_legend.runtimeApplyProven_global: FALSE — no live serverGameplaySettings publish has been performed on our box; only BuildOverrides observed inbound. First live action = gated single-partition durability test (#18).
